classification.difficultyReason: Identify each labelled angle's compass reference, then add to or subtract from a cardinal bearing or 360° and write three-digit bearings. The supplied compass cross makes these direct applications.

content.prompt: For the diagram opposite, write down the true bearing of points $A$, $B$, $C$ and $D$ from $O$.

spec.description: Compass cross with north and east arrowheads, four separately defined rays and all four labelled angle sectors. Source blue strokes and red point markers become ordinary black marks under house style.
spec.mathematics: OA has bearing 030 degrees; OB is 20 degrees south of east; OC is 50 degrees south of west; OD is 80 degrees west of north. Rays are not assumed collinear.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear; calculated bearings are confined to answers.

answer.worked: The clockwise angle from north to $OA$ is $30^\circ$, so the true bearing is $030^\circ\mathrm{T}$.

East is $90^\circ$ clockwise from north.

$$\text{Bearing of }B\text{ from }O=90^\circ+20^\circ=110^\circ.$$

The true bearing is $110^\circ\mathrm{T}$.

West is $270^\circ$ clockwise from north, and $OC$ is $50^\circ$ towards south from west.

$$\text{Bearing of }C\text{ from }O=270^\circ-50^\circ=220^\circ.$$

The true bearing is $220^\circ\mathrm{T}$.

The angle from north anticlockwise to $OD$ is $80^\circ$.

$$\text{Bearing of }D\text{ from }O=360^\circ-80^\circ=280^\circ.$$

The true bearing is $280^\circ\mathrm{T}$.
